## Deploy-window live validation for the f910 mcp-delta fix

The code fix for `waspy-piecemeal-queenconch` (f910) — teaching `autodeploy.sh`'s mcp delta gate
to OR `SECRETS_PATHS` via `mcp_delta()` — landed and merged (Gerrit change 2428, merged as
`b14d05dfc0b0`). Its code-verifiable acceptance criteria (AC1–AC3) are complete and tested.

f910's AC4 is a LIVE ON-BOX observation that inherently cannot be satisfied from a code snapshot
and could not be run under the read-only-box authoring constraint. It is deferred here so f910
can close on its delivered code fix while the operational check is tracked to completion.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] [non-codebase] At the next secrets-only deploy (a commit touching only `SECRETS_PATHS` —
      `infra/scripts/fetch-secrets.sh` or `infra/terraform/ssm.tf` — with no `MCP_PATHS` path
      changed), confirm on the prod autodeploy host that a NEW `rebar-mcp` container is built and
      started, and that its environment carries the newly-emitted value. Record in a comment: the
      autodeploy journal lines (`compose-build-mcp`, `run --name rebar-mcp-…`), the new container
      identity/id, and the deploy timestamp.
      provenance: environment=prod rebar autodeploy host (t4g.large); principal=deploy operator; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — verified by direct operator observation on the live prod box during the next secrets-only deploy; no code artifact can prove a running container's in-memory environment

## Context

Root cause, precedent (review-bot f600/incident-2731), fix, and RED evidence are on f910 and its
RCA comment. This ticket exists solely to carry the live post-deploy verification to done.

## Completion evidence (2026-09-07)

Secrets-only validation completed by rotating /rebar/prod/mcp-hmac-signing-key, re-materializing SSM secrets, blue/green replacing only MCP, verifying the new container consumed the new SSM version by equality+length only, exercising an authenticated production /mcp/ write request, and confirming autodeploy returned to clean no-op cycles.
